questions.question: Jesus asked how the Christ can be the son of the king who wrote in the book of Psalms. Which king?
Jesus warned that the scribes who cheat widows will receive a lighter condemnation. True or false?
When a poor widow gave two small coins, why did Jesus say she put in more than the rich?

answers.text: She put in all she had to live on
Her two coins were old and very rare
She gave in secret and told no one
